description: This PHP source file contains the implementation of a cURL-based HTTP client adapter class within the Zend Framework. It provides methods for configuring, connecting, sending HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.), reading responses, and managing cURL options, specifically tailored for integrating cURL functionalities into Zend's HTTP client infrastructure.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Curl
classes.description: A PHP class implementing the Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Interface for HTTP requests based on the cURL extension. Handles connection setup, request sending, response parsing, and resource management using cURL.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Configures the adapter with an array or Zend_Config object, setting various cURL options, proxy credentials, and connection parameters.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current configuration array for the cURL adapter.

methods.name: setCurlOption
methods.description: Sets a specific cURL option explicitly for the adapter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initializes a cURL session and connects to a specified host and port, with optional SSL parameters.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with method, URI, headers, and body via cURL, handling various HTTP methods and response processing.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Returns the server response stored after a request.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the cURL session and resets connection state.

methods.name: getHandle
methods.description: Returns the raw cURL resource handle.

methods.name: setOutputStream
methods.description: Sets a stream resource where output will be written during the request.

methods.name: readHeader
methods.description: A callback method to process headers received by cURL.
